CheckTitle: Ensure Qualified Target Filtering with WAF for SaaS is Enforced
Benchmark: CIS Oracle SaaS Cloud Applications Benchmark v1.0.0
RequiredAccess: Oracle SaaS Operations service request records
Description: Qualified Target Filtering applies different WAF rules per module, so internal modules are restricted while external portals (Supplier Portal, Candidate Experience) stay reachable.
Risk: One rule for every module either over-exposes internal modules or blocks external users.
AuditProcedure: Find the service request; review which modules are covered and the rules for each; test each module from allowed and disallowed sources.

Steps: Raise a service request listing modules and their restrictions, review Oracle's implementation and test.
